'''Ghorroh''' was a [[Gundark/Legends|gundark]] that lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]<ref name="Adventures" /> that lasted from [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> He had [[Color/Legends|red]] skin and brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. [[80-T5]], a [[GL-916's model|vendor droid]] who ran a stall in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] selling [[Species/Legends|creatures]] and [[Droid/Legends|droids]], had Ghorroh for sale.<ref name="Adventures" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|If Ghorroh ever tries to hug you, just make sure he's only using one pair of arms!|In-game store description for Ghorroh|<ref name="Adventures" />}}
Ghorroh appeared in the [[2010]] massively multiplayer [[Star Wars video games|online game]] [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] as a companion players could purchase with the in-game currency "Station Cash" at a price of SC 350. This article makes no assumptions about if Ghorroh was bought, as purchasing him is entirely optional.<ref name="Adventures" />
